description: List the users who liked or reacted to an object — a post, comment, photo or video — with counts per reaction. owner_id is negative for a community; item_id is the post or object ID.

owner_id.description: Owner ID of the object (negative for community)

reaction_id.description: Filter by reaction: 0 — like ❤️, 1 — laugh 😂, 2 — wow 😮, 3 — admiration 🔥, 4 — angry 😡, 5 — sad 😢

name: vk_likes_get

count.description: Total number of matches on VK, which is usually larger than the returned page

items.description: Users who reacted to the object

pagination.description: Where this page sits in the whole result. Call the tool again with offset set to next_offset to continue; when next_offset is null there is nothing left to fetch.

next_from.description: Cursor for the next page, on the tools that page by cursor rather than offset

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page, or null when this page is the last one

offset.description: The offset this page started at

returned.description: How many came back on this page

total.description: How many matches VK has in total

title: See who reacted
